newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:
There were no annoucements or questions made during today's Commission midday briefing.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/293: Commissioner Hans van den Breok visit to Estonia: focus on enlargement preparations.
- IP/97/295: Initialling of EU-U.S. agreement on drugs precursors on April 11, 1997.
- Speech/97/81: Speech by Commissioner Hans van den Broek on the EU/Estonia relations.
- IP/97/82: Speech by Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy at EBRD Board of Governors annual assembly.
- IP/97/84: Speech by Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard on news possibilities for industry at seminar on "Development of EU environmental policies".
- European Economy - Supplement B No 2/3 - February/March 1997: Capacity utilization and industrial investments.
- Eurostat news release No 28/97: EU unemployment: 10.8 % again in February.
